For each question, choose the correct answer.
Can dolphins talk?
Scientists know that dolphins are intelligent creatures. But now they are (21).................. whether the noises that dolphins make are actually a form of language.
Dolphins make various noises to communicate information to each other, about things like their location in the ocean. But scientists wanted to discover exactly how dolphins communicate when working together. So they recorded the noises that dolphins made while (22).................. a difficult exercise. The scientists had designed a box with ropes attached to either side. Inside the box were some fish. The box could be opened more (23).................. if two dolphins worked together — using the ropes to pull the box in opposite (24).................. to open it.
The dolphins made noises much more (25).................. while they were working together to (26).................. the problem. But does this mean that they were actually talking to each other? More research is needed before scientists can be sure.

questions.explanation:
“wonder whether” 为固定搭配，意为 “想知道是否”，符合科学家对海豚声音是否为语言的探究语境。
A. guessing（猜测）、C. thinking（思考）、D. believing（相信）均不与 “whether” 构成恰当搭配，且语义上不如 “wondering” 准确。
拓展：“wonder” 后可接疑问词引导的从句，如 “wonder how dolphins communicate”（想知道海豚如何交流）。

“complete a difficult exercise” 表示 “完成一项困难任务”，与 “科学家记录海豚执行任务时的声音” 语境一致。
B. reaching（到达）、C. ending（结束）、D. producing（产生）均无法与 “exercise” 搭配表达 “完成任务” 的含义。
拓展：“complete” 强调 “彻底完成”，名词形式为 “completion”，如 “the completion of an experiment”（实验的完成）。

“两只海豚合作时箱子能更轻易被打开”，“easily” 表示 “容易地”，体现合作降低任务难度的逻辑。
A. accurately（准确地）、B. properly（恰当地）、D. correctly（正确地）均与 “合作使任务变简单” 的语境无关。
拓展：“easily” 可修饰动词，如 “solve the problem easily”（轻松解决问题）。

“in opposite directions” 为固定短语，意为 “朝相反方向”，指海豚向不同方向拉绳子才能打开箱子。
A. routes（路线）、C. paths（路径）、D. positions（位置）均不与 “opposite” 搭配表示 “方向”。
拓展：“direction” 常见搭配：“in the direction of”（朝…… 方向）、“change direction”（改变方向）。

“more frequently” 表示 “更频繁地”，说明海豚合作时发声频率更高，符合研究交流方式的实验目的。
A. generally（通常）、B. immediately（立即）、C. usually（通常）均不强调 “频率增加”。
拓展：“frequently” 为频率副词，形容词为 “frequent”，如 “frequent conversations”（频繁的交流）。

“solve the problem” 为固定搭配，意为 “解决问题”，此处指海豚合作打开箱子（解决难题）。
A. answer（回答）后多接 “question”；B. explain（解释）、D. deal（处理）需搭配 “with”（deal with），均不符合语法。
拓展：“solve” 侧重 “找到问题的解决方案”，名词为 “solution”，如 “a solution to the problem”（问题的解决办法）。
